_comment: Operator-set agent tunables the deploy must carry (DL-100 / S169). Mechanism lives in infra/deploy-agents.ps1; these names and values are trading-pack data (ADR-0012). A full `up` REPLACES each app's env set, so a tunable that lives only as live cluster state is silently reverted to its code default with a green [OK]. This file is that single source of truth. Values are strings because container env vars are strings. Secrets never appear here - they arrive as secretrefs from Key Vault via master (DL-07).
_measured: Snapshot of the live fleet read on 2026-08-14 from Azure Container Apps RG trading-agents. STAGED 2026-08-20: DELIBERATOR_LLM_PROVIDER openai->anthropic on all three deliberators (DL-99 operator switch). The three *_MODEL vars are deliberately empty, so this resolves the Anthropic adapter default claude-opus-5. NOT YET APPLIED LIVE - the Anthropic key is blocked by an operator-set spend limit; live env still reads openai until that limit is raised. Both providers are currently non-functional, so the divergence degrades nothing. Amended 2026-08-19 (DL-116): grace 900->1800 and deliberator request timeout 60->120, measured off sched-2026-08-19 (debate span ~990s vs 900s grace; LLM tail 65.3/59.3/58.2s vs a 60s ceiling). Amended 2026-09-04 (S172 merge): DELIBERATOR_DEBATE_CONCURRENCY ships at 1, not the code default of 4. K=1 is the deployed status quo; K>1 measured 1.78x of a possible 4x and, on one of two runs, dead-lettered 6 peer replies with 2 of 15 orders failing open, so the fan-out merges as an available dial rather than as proven behaviour. Raising it is a deliberate edit here plus an `up`. Amended 2026-09-05 (S198, operator decision): ANALYST_STOP_TARGET_MODE flat->scaled, promoting the S150 challenger (ADR-0013 / DL-77). Measured first on the live graph over 269 recorded recommendations - scaled stops span 3.00/5.45/8.00 pct against a flat 5.00/5.00/5.00, and the reward-risk pass rate is 100 pct in BOTH modes, so DL-77's named trap (widen the stop, silently stop trading AMD/MRVL/HPE) does not bite on this book. The touch-rate half could not be measured at all - stop_target_observed_drawdown_pct had no producer - so S198 ships the recorder in the same change: the flip is auditable on our own trades from its first night, not only against DL-77's external 2026-04 backtest.
